interpretations: For each examination with a matching patient, compute its `aCL IgM` deviation from the mean across all matched examinations, then subtract the mean deviation for examinations whose patients have the same nonmissing `SEX` text. Return the 10 examinations with a positive excess, ordered by excess descending (missing values last), showing patient `ID`, `SEX`, `aCL IgM`, deviation, and excess; ignore missing values in averages and do not round
queries:
WITH matched AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM`
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        `aCL IgM`,
        `aCL IgM` - (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM matched) AS deviation
    FROM matched
),
excesses AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        `aCL IgM`,
        deviation,
        deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess
    FROM deviations
    WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(SEX) <> ''
)
SELECT ID, SEX, `aCL IgM`, deviation, excess
FROM excesses
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
